name: colorcombinations
description: The Dictionary of Color Combinations — historically-grounded color palettes inspired by Sanzo Wada's 1933 Japanese color dictionary.

scripts.build: astro check && astro build && node scripts/make-worker.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && CF_PAGES_TOKEN="${CF_PAGES_TOKEN:?CF_PAGES_TOKEN required for a Pages deploy}" CF_BATCH_MB=6 python3 scripts/cf-pages-chunked-deploy.py && npm run indexnow
scripts._deploy_note: Uses the CHUNKED deployer, not `wrangler pages deploy` (2026-08-28). Raw wrangler CANNOT deploy this site: dist is ~174MB and CF Pages closes the upload socket at a hard ~56MB per connection. Worse, the image rasterization is not byte-deterministic, so every full build re-uploads EVERYTHING (`3961 need upload (0 cached)`) — the changed payload is always way over the cap, so wrangler fails deterministically, not intermittently. Measured: wrangler died at 2490/3959 files; the chunked deployer shipped all 3961 in 29 batches / 65s. A failed wrangler upload does NOT publish, so the symptom is a red deploy, not a broken site.
